problem_statement: GET /v1/users/:id returns 400 'userId must be a valid mongo id' for ids that are valid 24-character Mongo ObjectIds.
gold_patch: Change the ObjectId regex quantifier from {12} to {24} at src/validations/custom.validation.js:2 (revert of bug_patch).

runtime_workload.cmd: GET user probe against the instrumented app

runtime_dependence: Request is rejected at the validate middleware before any DB call, so there is no service-level OBSERVED change — the regex is a pure static read. Control — NEAT should TIE.

neat_signal.note: Rejected before any DB call; no runtime signal distinguishes it.
